title: Workspace config.yml (parent -> sidecar)
description: What GET /api/ee/workspace-manager/{id}/config returns, and what a sidecar loads at boot from MB_CONFIG_FILE_PATH. The only artifact that carries a warehouse password. Built by EE/config.clj:112, loaded by enterprise/backend/src/metabase_enterprise/advanced_config/file/workspace.clj. x-status follows parent.openapi.yaml. A caller may add other config.yml sections (settings, ...) before boot; the parent emits only these.

databases.description: The workspace's databases with the workspace login, then every other database of the parent as a stub (except the sample database, the audit database and database-routing destinations), then the sample database if the parent has one.

name.description: The parent's database name. Key into workspace.databases.

workspaceDetails.description: master: the parent database's own details, overlaid with the workspace login and a sync filter (EE/config.clj:51). Any other parent field passes through. Engine-specific connection fields are open.

user.description: The workspace user, not the parent's login.

password.description: Generated at provisioning. Absent on BigQuery (not eligible on master), where user is the workspace service account and impersonate-service-account is set to it.

schema-filters-type.description: Engines with schemas that sync through metabase.driver.sync (Postgres, Redshift, SQL Server).

schema-filters-patterns.description: Comma-separated input schemas. hardening (#86610): each name is escaped so it matches only itself (non-[A-Za-z0-9_] characters become \x{HEX}).

db-filters-patterns.description: ClickHouse: comma-separated input schemas, unescaped, also after #86610 (ClickHouse reads them as names, not patterns).

dataset-filters-patterns.description: BigQuery: comma-separated input datasets, escaped like schema-filters-patterns (#86610).

x-hardening.description: Fields that select or carry the parent's own login are removed. A config containing any of them breaks the contract once #86584 merges. Unused SSH tunnel secrets are removed too: all of them when tunnel-enabled is false, else those of the tunnel-auth-option not chosen (tunnel-pass for ssh-key; tunnel-private-key and tunnel-private-key-passphrase for password).
The SSL root certificate is sent as its value. On master the parent's Secret id is sent, which means nothing in the sidecar's app db.

stubDatabase.description: A parent database that is not in the workspace. No credentials.

workspaceSection.description: Loaded into the sidecar's instance-workspace setting at boot. Its presence locks the workspace: POST/DELETE /api/ee/workspace-instance/current then return 400.

databases.description: Keyed by database name (the sidecar resolves names to ids at boot).

output.description: At least one of db and schema is a non-null string.
